name: Standing back extension
summary: Hands on the hips, lean back from the waist as far as is comfortable, then return.
setup: Stand side-on to the phone, feet apart, hands in the small of the back. Keep the knees straight and bend backward from the waist, hold a second, come back up.
brief: Feet apart, hands in the small of the back. Keep the knees straight and bend backward from the waist, hold a second, come back up.
why: Side-on, the shoulder–hip line leans back from vertical each rep, so reps are counted.
tempo: Back 2 s, hold 1 s, up 2 s.
regression: Hands higher on the back; smaller lean.
contraindications: Pain spreading down the leg on the lean.

faults.label: Not reaching the target
faults.tip: Take each rep through the full range you set — half reps count as partials.

faults.label: Too fast
faults.tip: Control both directions; momentum takes the work away from the muscle.

faults.label: Knees bending
faults.tip: Bending the knees turns it into a squat; the movement should come from the back.

faults.label: Throwing the head back
faults.tip: The neck stays in line; bend from the waist.

faults.label: Not pausing at the end
faults.cue: Hold one second at the end
faults.tip: A brief pause at the end of the lean is where the movement is gained.

guide.stop: Pain moving further down the leg.
guide.cannotSee: Whether the lean comes from the lower back or from the knees dropping.

points.t: Leans back from the hips; knees straight.
